text.T007:
What happens across review, testing, security and maintenance when generating code gets
        easier? This research synthesis studies AI-assisted software delivery as a complete system:
        verification capacity, code quality, technical debt and long-term ownership, with an
        inspectable evidence library and adaptable operating protocols.
text.T017:
How do we design and operate software whose behavior depends on probabilistic Model
        Judgment? Uncertainty Architecture develops an engineering vocabulary and draft
        specification for Thinking Systems, AI control architecture, evaluation, decision authority,
        runtime control and correction.
text.T023:
The repositories hold the living research and its sources. My articles connect the ideas across
    both directions.
